d023_additions.semantics: D023-2: evaluation mode requires this to equal the frozen OperationRecipe.code_sha256; ordinary command mode requires null. Schema enforces presence and form only; equality and mode are semantic check V32.

unchanged_definition_count_rationale: D023 adds one required field to an existing definition and tightens documented semantics of existing fields. It adds no new named definition, so the definition library stays at 106.

d023_documented_semantics_changes.change: No field change. D023-1 requires in-process delivery of the frozen protocol bytes and a read-only per-role resource closure reader alongside this object; the committed final location lives only in existing ArtifactRef fields.
Documented as the sealed, committed delivery record. The pre-commit DeliveredContextDraft is process-local and is deliberately not a JSON definition, so no fake serialized stream DTO exists.
primary_scope and primary_claim_id are mandatory and must name one exact frozen claim key.
primary_claim_id, primary_scope, exit_code and error remain mandatory; archive failure precedes verdict and forces assessment_ref null.
attempt is mandatory and is the pre-allocated attempt. execute does not allocate. StorageConfig is host-injected and absent from all Apps*Request definitions.
code_sha256 documented as the frozen expected code identity of the supported entrypoint/package scope, not an archived interpreter digest.
code_sha256 documented as the observed actual digest used for the pre-start comparison; never filled with the expected value when actual bytes could not be resolved.

warning: These legacy JSON leaves retain existing validation/encoding/hash; they are not inferrsi-json-v1 payloads. Machine schema is a design specification, not repository implementation. Documented here as Proposed, not an accepted or gate-approved contract.
